# `terraform stacks deployment-step show` reference

Use the `terraform stacks deployment-step show` command to show details of a deployment step.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks <global-stacks-flags> deployment-step show <options>
```

## Description

The `terraform stacks deployment-step show` command retrieves relevant information for a given deployment step, including atrifacts avalibility.

You can identify the target deployment step either by providing a deployment step ID directly.

## Options

- `-deployment-step-id`: The ID of the deployment step to show.
    - Required.
    - String data type.
- `-json`: Output results in JSON format.
    - Optional.
    - Boolean flag.
    - Default is false (human-readable output).

## Examples

The following command shows details of a deployment step using the deployment step ID:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-step show -deployment-step-id step-abc123def456
```

The following command shows details of a deployment step and outputs the result in JSON format:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-step show -deployment-step-id step-abc123def456 -json
```

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/cli/commands/stacks/global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
